recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Recreating ConceptMap2 would reverse the later approved transition; future ConceptMap work should target the active ConceptMap resource unless a new work-group decision explicitly creates another temporary artifact.
issue_request: FHIR-32853 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary WG FHIR-core ConceptMap issue for R5. It requested a new temporary StructureDefinition named ConceptMap2 containing all R5 ConceptMap changes already applied or ready to apply, plus a main resource-list entry so implementers could test the standard operations while the existing ConceptMap build continued to work.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-32853 was found. Commit 2330fc8eaafc521d6614e675dde6be257347180b created source/conceptmap2, structuredefinition-ConceptMap2.xml, examples, operations, search parameters, and active source/fhir.ini and resource-list entries; PR #1293 merged the branch in 5d6cda5c056d8c7f0d312864f2ac753f1d3bcc7a as "Added ConceptMap2."
additional_context: Vocabulary minutes from 2021-06-03 show FHIR-32853 was the first step in a temporary transition, paired with FHIR-32854 interim ConceptMap guidance and FHIR-32855 replacement/discard work. Commit 8623473ddfcef0cb88b9abf5241abfe6e28ea542 later moved ConceptMap2-era content into ConceptMap and removed active conceptmap2 entries from source/fhir.ini and the resource list. The combined branch already contains separate reconciliation commits for FHIR-32854, FHIR-32855, and FHIR-37789.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build actively lists conceptmap=ConceptMap, has no source/conceptmap2 folder or active conceptmap2 resource entry, has no current-source ConceptMap2 references in source, implementations, or publish.ini, and carries the post-transition definition in source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml.

related_jiras.note: Added interim ConceptMap guidance pointing readers to the ConceptMap2 artifact created by this issue; already represented on the combined branch.
Completed the ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap replacement and discarded ConceptMap2; already represented on the combined branch.
Removed the obsolete ConceptMap2 dragon warning after the transition completed; already represented on the combined branch.
